description: Play head expander for any Rainbow sequencer, placed immediately to the right of it, running three more playheads over the same notes

inputs.text: Advances that playhead on each rising edge; with nothing patched here the sequencer's own clock advances it
Returns that playhead to its first step

outputs.text: Carries the pitch of the note that playhead is on
Carries the gate of the note that playhead is on
Carries a gate while the note that playhead is on is muted
Carries a gate while that playhead is ratcheting
Carries a gate on the first step after that playhead reaches the end of its sequence

notes: The first of the four playheads is the sequencer's own, so its ports here repeat what the sequencer carries
With no Rainbow sequencer immediately to its left this module does nothing: the sequencer supplies the notes the extra playheads read
A Rainbow sequencer takes only one play head expander; a second one is refused with the message Play Head Expander already attached
